Claim 4 (Currently Amended): A method of impeding Leishmaniasis transmission in __dogs__ by means of administering to __a dog__, a composition comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from __Leishmania donovani promastigotes or Leishmania donovani amastigotes__ and saponin, __wherein said composition is administered as a vaccine that induces blocking antibodies in the dog__.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition is in the form of a blocking vaccine __comprising lyophilized FML antigen and Quil A saponin__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, __wherein the composition is reconstituted in sterile saline solution__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania __donovani__ promastigotes or Leishmania __donovani__ amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
